en: A black-and-white historical postcard showing a street scene in a European village. In the foreground, two young girls are dressed in traditional Alsatian folk costumes with large bows on their heads, standing beside soldiers and townspeople. Half-timbered houses with shuttered windows and French flags are visible in the background. The postcard contains both printed and handwritten French text.
